entities.summary: Seyed Mohammad Shirazi, commonly known as Sultan al-Wa'izin Shirazi, was a prominent Shi'a scholar. He authored Peshawar Nights, an account of a public debate between Shi'a and Sunni Muslims which took place in Peshawar over 10 nights beginning on 27 January 1927

entities.summary: Seyed Mohammad Shirazi, commonly known as Sultan al-Wa'izin Shirazi, was a prominent Shi'a scholar. He authored Peshawar Nights, an account of a public debate between Shi'a and Sunni Muslims which took place in Peshawar over 10 nights beginning on 27 January 1927
